sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; mixed small trades across parties; market sentiment neutral with slight bearish bias (AAII 35% bearish); greed reading (58) offers no contrarian edge; insufficient news data to confirm or contradict setup.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (169.16) indicates extreme market stress; earnings in 58 days adds event risk but not imminent.

debate.key_bull_argument: StochRSI cross-up, Supertrend bullish, and Ichimoku above cloud provide early oversold bounce signals with price near support (263.06) offering defined risk entry.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price below all major moving averages, weak ADX trend conviction, declining volume, zero fundamental support, extreme VIX (169.16), inverted yield curve, and earnings event risk in 58 days create a high false-signal environment with unfavorable macro backdrop.
